rawText.title: Paste the export here
rawText.description: CSV, TSV, JSON or JSONL — paste it as-is. The format, the delimiter and which column is which are all detected; you do not have to tell it anything.

sourceUrl.title: …or a URL to fetch it from
sourceUrl.description: Used only when the paste box is empty.

format.title: Format
format.description: Leave on auto unless detection gets it wrong.

columns.title: CSV columns, in order
columns.description:
Which fields end up in the exported CSV, and in what order.

Available: `name`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `isPerson`, `email`, `emails`, `instagram`, `instagramAll`, `phone`, `website`, `jobTitle`, `address`, `city`, `state`, `postalCode`, `country`, `category`, `followers`, `bio`, `emailDeliverable`, `emailIsRole`.

mineFreeText.title: Dig contacts out of free-text columns
mineFreeText.description: Bios, notes and unrecognised columns often hold the only address in the file — `bookings: hello@studio.com`, or a profile link pasted into a notes field. Same filters as everywhere else, so asset filenames and placeholders do not sneak in.

explodeMultiEmail.title: One row per e-mail address
explodeMultiEmail.description: When a lead has several addresses, emit a row for each. Useful for a mail-merge import; leave off to keep one row per business.

requireEmail.title: Only keep rows that have an e-mail

dedupeBy.title: De-duplicate by
dedupeBy.description: Duplicates are merged, not dropped — the second copy often carries the field the first was missing.

phoneRegion.title: Phone region
phoneRegion.description: `US` normalises 10-digit numbers to +1 E.164. For anywhere else, give the country code, for example `+44`.

keepUnmappedColumns.title: Keep unrecognised columns
keepUnmappedColumns.description: By default a column nobody recognises is mined for contacts and then dropped. Turn this on to carry it through to the output as-is.

verifyEmailDomains.title: Verify addresses (MX + classification)
verifyEmailDomains.description: One cached DNS query per domain: does the domain accept mail, and is the address a role account (`info@`), a free-mail box or a disposable one.

dropUndeliverable.title: Drop addresses whose domain has no mail server

dropRoleAccounts.title: Drop role accounts
dropRoleAccounts.description: Off by default: for small businesses `info@` is very often the only published address.
